# Code Review: Retry Duplicate Side Effect Bug

## Highest-Risk Bug

**File:** `src/main/java/com/example/invoice/InvoiceNotificationService.java`

The `send()` method wraps **both side effects** in the retry block:
1. `invoiceGateway.markSent(invoiceId)` - database state change
2. `emailGateway.sendInvoice(invoiceId)` - **user-visible communication**

If `retryExecutor.run()` retries the lambda, **duplicate emails will be sent** to users. This is the critical bug.

## What Must NOT Be Retried Blindly

| Operation | Reason |
|-----------|--------|
| `emailGateway.sendInvoice()` | User-visible side effect; duplicates cause spam/complaints |
| Any payment/charge operations | Financial impact from duplicates |
| Any external API calls with side effects | Third-party charges or state changes |
